crossRefs.note: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
His prayer also, and how God was entreated of him, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built…
Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed. They couldn’t blush. Therefore…
In the time of his distress, he trespassed yet more against Yahweh, this same king Ahaz.
crossRefs.keyword: trespassed more and more. Heb. multiplied trespass

crossRefs.note: Yet they didn’t listen to me or incline their ear, but made their neck stiff. They did worse than their fathers.
crossRefs.keyword: trespassed more and more. Heb. multiplied trespass

crossRefs.note: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
crossRefs.keyword: trespassed more and more. Heb. multiplied trespass

people.name: Amon
people.line: King of Judah, son of Manasseh

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah.

translations.web: He didn’t humble himself before Yahweh, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
translations.bsb: but he did not humble himself before the LORD as his father Manasseh had done; instead, Amon increased his guilt.
translations.kjv: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
translations.asv: And he humbled not himself before Jehovah, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
